indices: 騎士 の 時代 には 彼ら(かれら){彼等} は 剣[01] で(#2028980) の 戦い[01]{闘い} に依る{による} 怪我[01] から 身(み) を 守る 為(ため){ため} 鎧 を 身につける[02]{身に付けた}

original: また危ないことしてる。怪我しないでよ？

en.text: You're doing something dangerous again. Don't get yourself hurt, got it?
You're being dangerous again. Don't hurt yourself, okay?

original: 事故で怪我をされてから、歩けなくなられたのよ。

en.text: After he was injured in an accident, he could no longer walk.

original: トムは左手を怪我したんだ。

en.text: Tom hurt his left hand.

original: トムが怪我をしないか心配なんだよ。

en.text: I'm worried because Tom might get hurt.
I'm worried that Tom will get hurt.
I'm worried that Tom might get injured.

original: その間、息子はというと、足を怪我し、夏休みを待って、手術を受け、ずっと入院中だった。

en.text: During that time, speaking of my son, he had injured his leg, and, although he was looking forward to summer vacation, he had surgery and spent the whole time in the hospital.

original: 気をつけないと、誰か怪我するよ。

en.text: If we aren't careful, someone will get hurt.
If we aren't careful, someone's going to get hurt.
If you're not careful, someone will get hurt.

original: 人を殺したり怪我を負わせたりしたことなど一度たりともありません。

en.text: I have never killed nor injured anybody.
I've never killed nor injured anyone.
I've never killed nor injured anybody.

original: お前が怪我をしたんじゃないかと心配したんだぞ。

en.text: We were worried that you might've been injured.

original: 何があったの？怪我はない？

en.text: What happened to you? Are you hurt?
What happened? Are you hurt?
